queries.result: Official Xiangyin government pages were identified for the county Natural Resources Bureau, its Real Estate Registration Center, and an online natural-condition inquiry procedure. officialSources.observation: The bureau page assigns the Xiangyin Natural Resources Bureau responsibility for unified natural-resource and immovable-property registration, cadastral investigation/survey, registration information management, and related geospatial data management; it lists the Real Estate Registration Center as a subordinate institution.

The local government service guide says natural-condition inquiry is for natural persons, uses Xiangyi-ban or the Hunan online one-window platform, and queries house immovable-property information; the decision institution is the Xiangyin Real Estate Registration Center.
The center's official annual-report page describes online registration work and operation of the provincial unified one-database/one-platform registration system.
